name: Waklass Status Development
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y sqlite3 libsqlite3-dev && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && sudo mkdir -p /home/vscode/.local/bin /home/vscode/.local/share/pnpm /home/vscode/.codex && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.local /home/vscode/.codex && touch /home/vscode/.codex/config.toml && if ! grep -q '^cli_auth_credentials_store' /home/vscode/.codex/config.toml; then echo 'cli_auth_credentials_store = "file"' >> /home/vscode/.codex/config.toml; fi && curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh && if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; elif [ -f package.json ]; then pnpm install; else echo 'No package.json yet; skipping pnpm install.'; fi
